data.headline: Iran IRGC Navy seizes Marshall Islands-flagged oil tanker Advantage Sweet in Strait of Hormuz.
Iran seizes Panama-flagged oil tanker Niovi transiting Strait of Hormuz near Fujairah.
Iran seizes oil tanker St Nikolas off coast of Oman in Gulf of Oman; crude futures surge +3%.
Iran IRGC forces board and seize Portuguese-flagged container vessel MSC Aries near Strait of Hormuz.
Iran launches major ballistic missile strike against Israel; energy markets price in Strait of Hormuz risk premium.
Houthi militants hijack Galaxy Leader cargo vessel in Red Sea near Bab-el-Mandeb strait.
Major international tanker operators Maersk, BP, and Frontline suspend Red Sea & Suez transit due to drone attacks.
US and UK launch Operation Prosperity Guardian airstrikes on Houthi targets; Suez oil tanker traffic drops 45%.
Houthi missile strike damages bulk carrier True Confidence in Gulf of Aden, killing 3 crew members; shipping insurance rates spike.
US Treasury OFAC issues General License 44, temporarily lifting sanctions on Venezuela oil & gas exports.
US threatens to reinstate Venezuela oil sanctions as electoral reform commitments stall in Caracas.
US lets Venezuela oil sanction relief General License 44 expire; PDVSA heavy crude exports restricted.
Venezuelan presidential election dispute sparks political instability; US considers individual sanctions on PDVSA officials.
